evidence.excerpt: Bogićević prefers industry partners who can provide access to defect and rework records for at least 12 months; he is not in a position to take projects that require him to sign broad IP assignment agreements covering academic outputs. He is currently co-supervising two PhD students under HMLVCOST and has limited capacity for additional large project commitments before mid-2026.
